title: Report from Workshop on Dialogue alongside Artificial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Discussing the need for cross-cultural validation and deploying AI interventions across different countries to identify biases in AI systems trained predominantly on Western classroom data.
Highlighting the necessity of evaluating AI dialogue systems for their sensitivity and adaptability within multilingual educational settings.
Examining differential engagement and the potential for AI tools to exacerbate existing achievement gaps among students with varying resource levels and academic proficiencies.
